text:
maya_ops: Heads up: vendor (NexaSupply) quoted a new insurance add-on for EU returns on the last batch of A100s. Need clarity on who absorbs cost and if it affects RMA routing. Shipping is blocked at AMS customs. @leo_vendor any background?

leo_vendor: Thanks @maya_ops. Apologies — vendor told us they added a 'carrier liability surcharge' after Brexit-era paperwork changes. Quoted €450/unit for RMA insurance if they pick up. We pushed back, asking for waiver due to DOA evidence.

nina_logistics: AMS customs holds because the original shipper declared a 'resale' value mismatch. Need corrected commercial invoice before release. If vendor re-issues invoice we can route to DPD depot and process the RMA locally.

ashley_sre: Can we re-route to NL warehouse (on our PO) instead? That avoids cross-border re-export. But does that still trigger the vendor's surcharge?

leo_vendor: Vendor says surcharge applies on 'return-to-origin' via their account. If we take custody (local warehouse), surcharge drops to €120/unit + VAT. If we provide courier (our account), vendor wants reimbursement for admin €75 one-time.

tom_sales: What's the delta vs reserved capacity / replacement cost? If surcharge > spare capacity economics, maybe cheaper to accept vendor replacements and skip returns.

maya_ops: Estimate: 8 A100s stuck. Surcharge scenarios:
```
vendor_pickup = 450 * 8 = €3600
our_warehouse_handoff = 120 * 8 = €960 + VAT
our_courier_admin = €75 (one-time) + shipping
vendor_pickup_eta = 10 days
our_courier_eta = 3 days
```

nina_logistics: AWB candidates: NL1234567890, NL1234567891. I'll need corrected commercial invoices and the serial list. Use this helper to generate the label: 
```
shipgen --awb NL1234567890 --svc DPD --addr "NL Warehouse, Unit 5"
```

rma_bot: RMA Ticket created: RMA-20260318-4987 — status: pending vendor confirmation. Link: https://rma.internal/RMA-20260318-4987

leo_vendor: I pushed for a vendor waiver given DOA batch evidence (photos + logs). They requested serials + original invoices. Send the list and I'll escalate to their operations lead.

ashley_sre: Pushing serials now. Also note we want nodes rebuilt with NVIDIA driver 530.12 — if replacements arrive, ask them not to preinstall an image. ops-prep script below: 
```
#!/bin/bash
# minimal prep for replacements
apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl
# disable auto-image preload
echo "DO_NOT_PRELOAD_IMAGE=1" > /etc/ops-config
```

maya_ops: Decision: proceed with our courier (cheaper + faster). @tom_sales FYI — cost hits infra ops this quarter. I'll update the finance SOW. :point_up:

tom_sales: Acknowledged. Please cc finance@redwood.com and I'll flag in next review. :ok_hand:

nina_logistics: I'll schedule pickup 2026-03-21 09:00 CET with DPD NL warehouse and confirm AWBs once labels are generated.

rma_bot: RMA updated: courier assigned DPD, ETA ~3 days. Status: in-transit (pending customs docs).
